title: Tiny Textures!
description: This texture pack attempts to change the games resolution to half it's original
body: This texture pack attempts to scale down the game’s resolution to half of its original size. While some textures may appear nearly unchanged and keep their original look, others will undergo a more dramatic transformation, resulting in a noticeably different style. The goal is to create a unique visual experience that feels both familiar and fresh. We hope you enjoy the new perspective this pack brings to the game!
